rationale: The discussion has become highly quantified and procedurally disciplined, but the core clash remains unresolved: employee/state actors still insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/investors/family keep footprint reduction on the table if the residual gap remains material. The last two rounds show stable hardening rather than convergence, so a mediator intervention or decision rule on residual-gap thresholds is now needed rather than more repetition.
